learning_outcomes.text: Fundamental theoretical and practical knowledge regarding the dynamics of machines and drive systems.
Recognize, describe, evaluate, and solve dynamic problems occurring in drive systems and machines, and derive scientifically sound judgments from them.
Independently learn the role of machine dynamics in mechanical engineering. This is to be demonstrated in advanced personal machine applications.
Recognize interface problems and address them in interdisciplinary collaboration.
Communicatively present and disseminate the dynamic stresses of mechanical engineering apparatuses.

syllabus_topics: Classification and tasks of machine dynamics
Determination of dynamic parameters – analytical / experimental
Balancing and running behavior of rotors
Free undamped / damped vibrations with one degree of freedom
Methods for determining the natural angular frequency of technical vibration systems (influence coefficient method)
Forced vibrations with one degree of freedom
Linear vibrations with several degrees of freedom
Modal analysis with finite element method
Balancing technology in theory - rigid and elastic rotor
Balancing machines - displacement-measuring and force-measuring balancing machines
Measurement technology and evaluation of vibrations: FFT, DFT
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
